description: This file defines a final class 'JSON' that provides utility methods for creating, parsing, and converting JSON data using Jackson's ObjectMapper. It includes methods to instantiate JSON objects from InputStream, Reader, String, and generic objects, as well as methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A thread-safe utility class for handling JSON serialization and deserialization using Jackson's ObjectMapper.

methods.name: from(InputStream)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from an InputStream, assuming UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: from(Object)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a generic Java object by serializing it to a JSON string.

methods.name: from(Reader)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a Reader.

methods.name: from(String)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a JSON string.

methods.name: toObject(Class<T>)
methods.description: Converts the JSON string to an object of the specified class.
